# Alex Pagtakhan — Data Analyst and Power BI Developer

Alex Pagtakhan is a Manila-based Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst with five years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operations reporting, workflow automation, and performance management.

- [Power BI Developer profile](https://alex-analytics-portfolio.vercel.app/power-bi-developer/): Power BI, DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, KPI reporting, and automation capabilities.
